_comment: Tier 0 solar LOCAL circumstances — NASA/Espenak, Solar Eclipse Visibility from Major Cities. Companion to nasa-eclipses.json, which is geocentric. Times are LOCAL STANDARD time (never daylight): UT = local - utcOffsetHours. A time carrying the flag `r` or `s` is clipped to sunrise/sunset and is NOT a contact time. An eclipse absent from a site is not visible from that site; these catalogs are complete over 0001-3000 CE, which is what makes that inference sound. Regenerate with `node notes/eclipse-local-fetch.mjs`.
reference: Eclipse Predictions by Fred Espenak, NASA/GSFC
